title: Global search — exact tag match ranked first
objective: Verify /search/assets?q=<exact tag> returns the exact-tagged asset as the first result.
preconditions: seeded assets; one with known tag T and others with similar names.
test_data: q = exact tag T; q = partial tag
steps: GET /api/v1/search/assets?q=<T> as operator.
GET /api/v1/search/assets?q=<partial of T>.
Inspect ordering of results.
expected_result: Exact tag match appears first; partial search returns ranked matches across tag/serial/name/model; results scoped to user permissions; response shape consistent with list envelope or documented search contract.

title: Search across fields — serial, name, model, custodian, location
objective: Verify global search matches assets by serial number, name, model, custodian name, and location per spec.
preconditions: seed asset with distinctive serial/name/model; an assigned custodian and location with distinctive names.
test_data: queries: serial substring, name substring, model substring, custodian surname, location name
steps: Run each query against /search/assets (or /assets?search=).
Verify the target asset is present in each result set.
expected_result: Each query returns the expected asset; no matches for unrelated gibberish query (empty result set, not error).

title: List filters — status, category, department, condition combined
objective: Verify server-side filters on /assets combine correctly (AND semantics) and respect scope.
test_data: filter combos: status=in_stock; category=<uuid>; status+category; condition+department
steps: GET /api/v1/assets?status=... for each combo as admin.
Verify every returned row satisfies all filter criteria.
Repeat one combo as deptmgr and verify scope intersection.
expected_result: All results match every applied filter; count envelope consistent; dept-scoped user sees only in-scope matches; invalid filter values yield 400 with field_errors, not 500.

title: Sorting server-side on supported columns
objective: Verify ordering parameter sorts ascending/descending on name, tag, created_at, updated_at; invalid sort fields rejected or ignored safely.
steps: GET /assets with each ordering value; verify result ordering.
Send bogus ordering value.
expected_result: Results correctly ordered for supported fields (verify programmatically adjacent pairs); bogus field returns 400 or is ignored with default order — never 500.

title: Pagination envelope, defaults, and max page_size
objective: Verify pagination contract: envelope {count, next, previous, results}; default page_size 25; page_size capped at 100.
steps: GET /assets with no params — verify envelope and 25 results.
GET page=2 — verify next/previous links and distinct results.
GET page_size=5 — verify 5 results and correct count.
GET page_size=10000 — verify capped at 100 (or 400 per contract).
GET page=99999 — verify behavior (empty results or 404 per contract).
expected_result: Envelope keys present and typed correctly; default 25; over-max page_size handled per contract (clamp to 100 or 400 VALIDATION_FAILED); out-of-range page yields empty results or documented 404 — never 500; no duplicate or missing rows across sequential pages.

title: Filter/sort/pagination state synced to URL query params
objective: Verify the asset register reflects filters, sort, and page in the URL and restores state on reload/share.
test_data: apply status filter + sort by name desc + page 2
steps: On /assets, apply a status filter, change sort, go to page 2.
Observe URL query params.
Copy URL, open in new tab/incognito-after-login.
Verify identical view state restored.
Use browser Back after changing filters.
expected_result: URL contains filter/sort/page params; shared URL reproduces the exact view; Back/Forward navigates filter history correctly; no state lost on reload.

title: Global search box UI — keyboard navigable suggestions
objective: Verify top-bar search shows suggestions, exact-tag-first, fully keyboard operable, and unknown terms yield a clear empty state.
test_data: exact tag query; name substring; gibberish 'zzzqqq'
steps: Focus global search via keyboard; type a query.
Arrow-key through suggestions; press Enter on one.
Search gibberish; observe empty state; press Escape.
expected_result: Suggestions appear with exact tag first; arrow keys move visible focus (aria-activedescendant); Enter opens the asset detail; gibberish shows accessible 'no results' message; Escape closes suggestion list with focus restored to input.

title: Search/list performance smoke
objective: Smoke-check that filtered asset search responds within the p95 ≤2s target at seed volume (~200 assets) with wide margin.
preconditions: seeded stack; timing tool (curl -w or pytest timing).
steps: Execute each query 3 times warm; record response times.
Compute rough average/max.
expected_result: All responses well under 2s at seed volume (expect <500ms); no query-time errors; results consistent across repeats. (Full-volume perf test is Cycle 3.)
